data.body: **[P2] Preserve the preparation failure when the End hook also fails.** If serialization/checkpointing throws and `onInvocationEnd` then throws an unisolated `Error`, the End error replaces the preparation failure without suppression. In particular, a preparation `VirtualMachineError` can be hidden by a later `AssertionError`, so the fatal is never propagated. Combine both failures using the lifecycle fatal-precedence rules, retaining the loser as suppressed, and add a combined delivery/End failure test.
